name: owner move-in is rejected on a UNOWNED, VACANT unit
title: SC-08-07-07 owner move-in is rejected on a UNOWNED, VACANT unit
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit in state UNOWNED, VACANT
When the Site Manager requests owner move-in
Then the request is rejected and the unit remains in state UNOWNED, VACANT
And no occupancy or ownership row is inserted or modified
